abstract: Gestational trophoblastic disease cases encountered in 88 pregnant women during a period between January 1985 and June 1992 were retrospectively studied. During the same period we had 6800 deliveries. The incidence of gestational trophoblastic diseases was 12.9 per 1000 deliveries. Of these cases 72 (81.8%) were diagnosed as hydatidiform mole and 16 (18.2%) were diagnosed as choriocarcinoma in histopathological investigations. The preferred method of treatment for cases of hydatidiform mole was termination with suction curettage and oxytocin perfusion. Trophoblastic diseases were common in women with five or more pregnancies from rural areas and our incidence was higher when compared with similar studies. Moreover, our patients had low socio-economic and poor educational status. All these factors seem to be etiologic reasons, besides multiparity.
abstract_ja: 1985年1月から1992年6月の間に、88例の妊娠婦において妊娠性絨毛性疾患の症例を後方視的に検討した。同期間の分娩数は6800件であった。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発生率は、分娩1000件あたり12.9であった。これらの症例のうち、72例(81.8%)は組織病理学的検査で胞状奇胎と診断され、16例(18.2%)は絨毛癌と診断された。胞状奇胎の治療法として好ましいのは、吸引掻爬とオキシトシン点滴による妊娠中絶であった。妊娠性絨毛性疾患は、経産回数が5回以上の農村部の女性に多かった。本施設の発生率は、類似の研究と比較して高かった。さらに、患者は社会経済的地位が低く、教育水準も低かった。これらの要因は、多経妊とともに病因となっていると考えられる。
